source_cohort.scope: Partial original-grid development pilot; no validation/test anchors

selection_algorithm.hash: SHA256 UTF-8 hex digest; ascending lexicographic rank
steps: Within each family rank distinct group IDs with kind=group,value=family+|+group_id; take first two.
Within each selected group rank distinct item IDs with kind=item,value=family+|+group_id+|+item_id; take first.
Within each selected item/group rank eligible frozen cell IDs with kind=cell,value=cell_id; take first.
selection_algorithm.ties: Break digest ties with the corresponding original identifier; no tie occurred in this panel.

audit_policy.baseline: Retain raw/capped sample0 and applicable unchanged component parents.
audit_policy.supplements: At most two separately labeled method-specific changed examples when fixed anchors miss changes; improvement/regression or explicit no-gain, with deterministic source/category selection. Never replace anchors.
audit_policy.missing_outputs: Mark unavailable evidence as missing; empty abstentions and unchanged outputs remain valid observations.
audit_policy.independent_reader: No new reader/model work; missing J++ anchor diagnostics stay missing. Existing instrument/E2 cases may supplement with separate scope.
audit_policy.feedback: Evaluation-only retrospective qualitative review. No context, labels or reviewer annotations enter selectors/helpers or alter frozen menus.

limits: Eight illustrative development cells, two distinct items/related groups per family; not a population estimate or exhaustive variant review.
Claim support and relational correctness require source context; number/name mentions and judge passes alone do not establish faithfulness.
Rare-change supplements are deliberately selected and must not be treated as representative.
review: Root independently reproduced all eight anchors from cohort metadata and the stated hash ranking. No output, judge result or method gain used for selection.
artifact_policy: Use actual retained frozen-run outputs and fresh-capture provenance for review. Older cache references in the split manifest establish cell metadata only; do not recapture or read old vectors for this audit.
